competitor_advantages.point: Touchpoint markets differentiators of ~80% loyalty program participation (vs. a claimed ~15% industry average), 99.95% platform uptime with 5x redundancy, merchant ownership of transaction/member data in a private data warehouse, and compatibility with legacy Windows/Android/iOS hardware.

latest_cos_commentary.headline: Touchpoint is a venture-backed, bootstrapped-origin unified commerce platform (OmniFusion) targeting enterprise multi-location QSR and coffee/pizza chains with a single-portal POS+KDS+ordering+loyalty stack.
latest_cos_commentary.genius_exposure: Competes directly with Genius's pos, kitchen_drive_thru, and loyalty_engagement lines by offering a single-vendor consolidation play aimed at chains currently running fragmented point solutions.
latest_cos_commentary.competitive_timing: Company is still small (11-50 employees per aggregator data) and has not published named customer case studies, suggesting an early enterprise sales stage rather than broad market penetration.
latest_cos_commentary.sales_response: Where a prospect cites 'unified platform' or 'single portal' messaging, confirm whether they've evaluated Touchpoint; ask for specifics on uptime/loyalty-participation claims and request references, since none are publicly documented.
latest_cos_commentary.risk_and_uncertainty: No independently verified customer list, revenue, or market share data exists; leadership and funding details rely on a single profile piece and aggregator sites rather than a primary press release.

verification_needed: named customer case study (none published as of research date)
confirm funding total and investor list via primary press release (currently sourced only from data-broker aggregators)
